locator.section: In Commemoratione Baptismatis D.N.I.C., Antiphona ad Communionem, Matth. 2, 2

entries.claim: The Mass of the Commemoration of the Baptism prints this Communion in full. Its words equal page 38 and the selected text; it prints Oríente, with the accent misplaced, and no comma after it (in Oríente et vénimus), where page 38 and the selected text have Oriénte, et.
The cited page image prints and identifies the complete 1962 liturgical component selected here; shared expansions are bounded in the witness record.
